victory_locked.label: Victory Locked
victory_locked.description: Proof has been verified, witnessed, and locked via a victory-lock artifact with commit-pinned, scenario-specific evidence.

proven_local_mock.label: Proven (Local Mock)
proven_local_mock.description: Proof passes in a local sandbox or mock harness. Not production-validated.

proven_cloud_demo.label: Proven (Cloud Demo)
proven_cloud_demo.description: Proof validated on cloud infrastructure (GKE). Demo scope, not production.

implementation_present.label: Implementation Present
implementation_present.description: Code or contract implementation exists but has not been formally proven.

planned.label: Planned
planned.description: Design or specification exists; implementation and proof are future work.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Proof is blocked by a known dependency or gap.

not_claimed.label: Not Claimed
not_claimed.description: Explicitly not claimed — see non-claims for details.

capabilities.name: At-Least-Once Delivery (Failure Injection)
capabilities.description: Scenario-specific proof: target_500 → retry (3 attempts) → succeed. At-least-once delivery with idempotency via failure injection. Local mock harness only.

capabilities.name: Control Plane Outage Reconciliation
capabilities.description: Scenario-specific proof: CP outage with cached policy → reconnect → converge. Conflict-free CP outage reconciliation in local mock.
non_claims: Not CP autonomy for all scenarios

capabilities.name: Retry Exhaustion and DLQ Routing
capabilities.description: Scenario-specific proof: target always fails → retry exhaustion → DLQ terminal state. Local mock harness only.

capabilities.name: Duplicate Detection and Idempotent Acceptance
capabilities.description: Scenario-specific proof: duplicate event → idempotency recognition → no extra delivery. Local mock harness only.

capabilities.name: Conflict Reconciliation
capabilities.description: Scenario-specific proof: CP state diverges during outage → conflict → resolution via remote_wins. Local mock harness only.

capabilities.name: Topology Drift Detection and Alignment
capabilities.description: Scenario-specific proof: topology version drift → detection → auto-correction. Local mock harness only.

capabilities.name: Evidence Buffer Flush
capabilities.description: Scenario-specific proof: evidence buffered during outage → flush in order → complete. 5-item buffer, order preserved, no duplicates. Local mock harness only.
non_claims: Not zero-loss for all buffer scenarios

capabilities.name: Relay Path Convergence
capabilities.description: Scenario-specific proof: direct path unavailable → relay → target succeeded. Single relay path convergence in local mock.

capabilities.name: Relay Failover Recovery
capabilities.description: Scenario-specific proof: primary relay fails → secondary → target succeeded. Single relay failover in local mock.

capabilities.name: Private-Edge Path Convergence
capabilities.description: Scenario-specific proof: edge → private_edge → mock data target succeeded. Single private-edge path in local mock.
non_claims: Not private data plane general availability

capabilities.name: SPIFFE/SPIRE Workload Identity
capabilities.description: SPIFFE SVID-based identity on Zen-managed internal paths including control-plane (agent ↔ SaaS) and data-plane (ingester ↔ egress) delivery hops. mTLS enforced where SPIFFE is deployed. Fail-closed where production policy requires it.
non_claims: Not SPIFFE on every workload (coverage is partial — some components use file-based SVIDs or static certs)
Not full SPIRE Workload API SVID rotation (post-V1)
Not production-live cloud attestation for all paths

capabilities.name: mTLS Enforcement
capabilities.description: Mutual TLS enforced on Zen-managed internal paths including control-plane (agent ↔ SaaS, BFF ↔ backend) and data-plane (ingester ↔ egress) delivery hops. Fail-closed where production policy requires mTLS. Local mock and sandbox CI validation.
non_claims: Not mTLS on every possible path (customer-managed egress → target is configurable, not Zen-mandatory)
Not production-live cloud E2E attestation for all hops
Not zero-downtime rotation proven on every workload

capabilities.name: Zero-Trust Boundaries
capabilities.description: Zero-trust-oriented controls (SPIFFE identity, mTLS, HMAC, policy-based authz) implemented on Zen-managed internal paths including control-plane and data-plane delivery hops. Coverage is partial — not every workload and not customer-managed endpoints.
non_claims: Not blanket zero-trust on every path
Not full SPIRE Workload API coverage (post-V1)
Not production-live cloud attestation for all paths

capabilities.name: Evidence Integrity via Integrity Chain
capabilities.description: Integrity chain used for evidence integrity verification. Fixture-validated (4 files PASS). Integrity verification is evidence integrity only — it is not an access control function, access decision rule, or send confirmation.

capabilities.name: Secretless Operations
capabilities.description: Architecture designed for secretless operation — no static secrets in config, SPIFFE for workload identity, short-lived credentials. Scope: control-plane paths.

capabilities.name: Policy-Based Authorization
capabilities.description: Authorization decisions based on policy rules evaluated against SPIFFE identity. Contract-defined with conformance fixtures.
non_claims: Not RBAC proven in failure scenarios

capabilities.name: Rotation and Revocation Support
capabilities.description: Per-type rotation is implemented: HMAC key rotation (HMACKeyRotationController, 90-day with grace), TLS/certificate renewal (cert-manager auto-renewal), JWK/JWKS rotation (kid versioning), and file-based X.509 SVID lifecycle (cert-manager renewal). Certificate expiry and revocation behavior has validation evidence. Full SPIRE Workload API SVID rotation is post-V1.
non_claims: Not full SPIRE Workload API SVID rotation (post-V1)
Not zero-downtime rotation proven on every workload in cloud production
Not ZenLock as universal rotation engine (ZenLock provides custody/distribution/audit; each lifecycle owns its rotation)

capabilities.name: Audit Trail
capabilities.description: Evidence buffer flush preserves ordered delivery evidence for audit. Audit trail exists for mock scenarios only.

capabilities.name: Tamper Evidence via Integrity Chain
capabilities.description: Integrity chain provides tamper detection for evidence artifacts. Any modification changes the hash. Local mock only.

capabilities.name: Compliance Control Mapping (Internal Readiness)
capabilities.description: Internal mapping of technical controls to compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, NIST SP 800-53, SOC2, ISO 27001, HIPAA). Maps-to and supports relationships only — not certification.

capabilities.name: Runtime Proof Matrix
capabilities.description: 18-entry runtime proof matrix covering delivery, convergence, visibility, route-truth verification, failover, retry, evidence integrity, API/MCP surfaces, conflict reconciliation, drift, CP outage, buffer flush, non-claims, and governance. Local mock / implementation only. Validated with 15-check validator.
non_claims: Matrix is governance artifact, not runtime proof
All runtime proofs are local/mock deterministic
Non-claims: exactly-once, zero-loss, general at-least-once, relay HA, production zero-trust, compliance certification

capabilities.name: Completion Evidence Gate
capabilities.description: Completion evidence contract enforcing that validated non-UI work must publish evidence artifacts, integrity leaf/root inclusion, docs discoverability, and explicit non-claims. 7 backfilled entries for tasks 002-008. 15-check validator. Integrity-indexed (7 leaves).
non_claims: Completion evidence is governance metadata, not runtime proof
No production-live status claimed for any backfilled task

capabilities.name: Integrity Evidence Index (Completion-Indexed)
capabilities.description: Canonical integrity evidence index with 5 bundles including completion evidence gate (7 leaves). All integrity roots deterministically generated and verified. Provides comparison only. See non-claims for scope.
non_claims: Not auth, identity verification, or principal attestation
Not encryption, replay prevention, or access control
Not delivery guarantee or ordering guarantee

Sandbox disabled truthfully represented in capabilities

Not IRAP eligibility claim or approval
Not funding eligibility, qualification, or approval of any kind

Technical evidence mapping only for future review readiness support
